zones.title: Zones
zones.description: A zone is a group of cameras that share notifications and pauses. List the cameras in order of importance: when several cameras in a zone see a person at the same time, the notification shows the first one.

error.default_not_selected: The default camera must be one of the selected cameras.
error.zone_names: Each zone needs a name, and the names must be different.
error.zone_name_all: "all" is reserved: it means every zone in the pause services.
error.zone_cameras: Each zone needs at least one camera.

pause_zone.name: Pause zone notifications
pause_zone.description: Pause the notifications of a zone, or of all zones, for a number of minutes.

resume_zone.name: Resume zone notifications
resume_zone.description: End the pause of a zone, or of all zones.
